items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: One fellow that had a great band was named Bart Howard.

ctx.x: I see. Now, before we leave Detroit, I just wanted to ask you what was going on in Detroit at that time, musically?

Well, they had four or five great bands. One fellow that had a great band was named Bart Howard. Now, they had large bands there. They had bands of 12 pieces, and like that. I don't think there was any larger than
